active_objective:
Generate a deterministic consumer-specific `npm-shrinkwrap.json`, include it
in every candidate tarball, derive one canonical production closure from it,
and independently compare fresh installed graphs with that closure. Prove
supported npm versions preserve the exact graph while missing, mutated,
transplanted, extra, stale, dev-contaminated, or semver-drifted states fail
closed.
stop_condition: Stop S19 if packed shrinkwrap is ignored, rewritten, incomplete, dev-contaminated, inconsistent across supported npm versions, dependent on mutable registry metadata for verification, or if package/closure/tree drift can false-green; stop the arc on provider, privacy, experiment, publication, deployment, or assurance-transfer crossover.
